title: Fleet Tuner: interactive scaling controls, throughput insights, and immutable change log for Dedicated
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Add a consolidated Fleet Tuner page in Console that lets operators: (1) set and preview interactive scaling controls (min/max nodes, per-route throughput caps, burst buffers), (2) view high-fidelity throughput dashboards (per-fleet, per-model, tail-latency/percentiles, queued requests), and (3) inspect an immutable change log for all scaling policy edits with author, diff, and rollback. This ticket covers product requirements, high-level UX flows, rollout gating, and acceptance criteria for GA-ready behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A Fleet Tuner page exists under Console > Capacity > Fleet Tuner
Operators can edit scaling controls and see a deterministic preview of expected throughput and cost delta before commit
Throughput dashboard shows 1m/5m/1h aggregates, p50/p95/p99 latency, queue depth, and capacity headroom for each fleet and model variant
Every change to scaling controls is recorded in an append-only change log with timestamp, actor, previous/next state, and associated GitHub PR or Confluence note (if provided)
Rollbacks can be executed from the change log UI and surface a dry-run impact estimate before applying
RBAC: only users with Fleet Admin role can commit changes; Viewer role can view dashboards and the change log but cannot edit
Console integrates with existing alerting: when a committed change increases risk to SLOs (predicted), a confirmation modal requires a secondary approval
Telemetry events emitted for every preview, commit, and rollback for billing and experiment instrumentation
notes: 2026-02-16: Kickoff with Eng (runtime/autoscale team) and Design. Agreed scope: no per-request policy editing in v1; focus on fleet-level and per-route caps.
2026-02-20: UX decision to show cost delta as estimated tokens/hr and dollars/hr using current usage mix. Rafael (Finance) provided conversion rates.
2026-02-25: Eng requests explicit constraint: preview must be computed client-side from cached stats + server-side check to prevent stale previews under >5% metric drift.
2026-03-02: Security reviewed append-only log requirements. Decided to support export to S3/WORM and integrate with KMS for log signing in Private deployments.
2026-03-05: Prototype Figma link added; Design attached for review cycles. Need to add compact mobile layouts for on-call flows.
2026-03-09: Working build of dashboard charts (backend metrics + slow query protection). Frontend needs 'compare-to-baseline' overlay for before/after previews.
comments: Liam O'Connell (2026-02-16): Initial tech constraints - autoscaler only accepts integer node counts for committed policies; will emulate fractional capacity in preview as % throughput. Planning spike to add per-route shard allocation later.
Maya Rivera (Design) (2026-02-20): UX proposal uploaded: show a three-column layout (controls | preview simulation | change history). Requesting space for safety gates and approval hints.
Ethan Zhou (Eng) (2026-02-25): Need to define data retention for dashboard: 90 days hot, 1 year warm. Long-term archival must be optional customer setting due to cost.
Priya Nair (Security) (2026-03-02): Change log must include immutability guarantees for regulated customers; suggest option to store signed manifests in KMS-backed storage.
Asha Kapoor (PM) (2026-03-06): Stakeholder demo scheduled 2026-03-12. Focus on rollback workflow and cost preview accuracy.
implementation_risks: Preview accuracy: prediction model may diverge under bursty workloads leading to false confidence
Permission model complexity across Hosted/Dedicated/Private may require several code paths
Immutability for change log in Private/on-prem requires extra infra and could delay GA
